**Handoff is in [HANDOFF.md](HANDOFF.md).** Root cause: `dep-4471` flipped `gateway.pool.perRequest` to true. The 20-slot pool pins full and requests queue.

Impact ran `02:14:18.972Z` to `03:59:27.974Z`, still firing at the end of the log. 530 failures, about 83% of requests. Only `/health` survived.

Roll back `dep-4471`. The one key to revert is `gateway.pool.perRequest`.

Next: nothing. Workers are ruled out in the doc.
